proposed.rationale: Cup 100347058 explicitly has handle=none, satisfying the negation mode for a cup without a handle.
Bowl 100353730 is porcelain and bowl 100408047 is glass, providing both branches of the either/or for serving bowls in glass OR porcelain.
Jug 100437750 has capacity expressed in L (1,5 L = 1500 ml), enabling unit conversion between L, cl, and ml.
Vase 100465402 has explicit height (200 mm) and distinct diameter (155 mm), satisfying the dimension mode with two distinct axes.
Drinking glass 100404522 has explicit pack count of 6 and capacity of 25 cl per glass, satisfying pack_capacity mode.
Table 100455702 is explicitly solid_oak and table 100478281 is explicitly oak_veneer, providing the required solid-oak positive and oak-veneer contrast.
Pan 100456331 is explicitly induction-compatible (induction=true), satisfying the compatibility mode.
Pan 100468229 is explicitly stainless_steel_aluminium AND explicitly has coating=none, satisfying both exclusion criteria for combined_exclusions.
Jug 100437750 has both explicit capacity (1500 ml) and explicit material (abs_plastic), enabling specificity mode to add one correct attribute at a time.

Pan 100414744 has member price 499.95 DKK (<500) but regular price 969.95 DKK (>=500), satisfying conditional_price. Pan 100456331 has public price 249.95 DKK (<500 DKK unconditionally) as the contrast.
